title: 第8章 井中棺，庙外神
content_zh:
第8章井中棺，庙外神
黄思平、韦褚和蛇妖蚖七见许应呆住，直勾勾的看着井底，也纷纷向井中看来。
一人一神一妖，目光与井中大眼接触，眼睛也变得呆滞，直勾勾看着井中的大眼睛。
那只大眼仿佛有一种奇异的力量，让他们看一眼便再难挪开。
突然，振聋发聩的钟响传来，将许应等人震醒。
两人一神一妖定睛看去，只见自己手上身上都是血，正抓着井中粗大的锁链，奋力往外拉！
蛇妖蚖七没有手，则是用自己的尾巴卷着锁链往外拖！
井中锁链已经被他们拖出了几十丈，到后面被拖出的锁链竟然满是黑血，腥臭扑鼻，令人作呕。
一起被拖上来的，竟还有十几具人骨！
众人毛骨悚然。
他们根本不知道自己何时失去神智，也不知自己的大脑被什么东西所控制，不知自己拖拽了多久，更不知锁链下锁着的是什么！
他们只觉锁链沉重无比，而且越来越沉，仿佛下面拴着什么东西。
井中，大眼睛消失不见，正在翻涌着血水，咕嘟咕嘟的冒着气泡，血水越来越高，已经来到井口！
许应等人急忙松开锁链，钟声再度响起，锁链哗啦哗啦往井中坠去，井中血水也自回落。
突然井中传来一声柔弱的叹息，极为好听，仿佛井中有个妙龄少女在哀叹自己的不幸，未能从井中脱困。
这声音越好听，许应等人便越是毛骨悚然。
许应站在井边向下看去，只见血水退去，锁链锁着是一口棺材，正沿着井壁笔直的往下坠。
片刻后，棺材坠到井底。
井底有一个尖锐的三角形嘴巴，满口利齿，将那棺材吞入口中，咽下，锁链如同胡须，挂在那庞然大物的嘴边。
许应心里怦怦乱跳，只见那庞然大物吞掉棺材之后，来到深井的正下方，张开嘴巴。

许应急忙缩头，拽着蛇妖蚖七的尾巴便跑！
黄思平和韦褚不解，突然井口传出惊天动地的怒吼，将黄思平、韦褚震得各自闷哼，眼耳口鼻都是鲜血！
井中，那庞然大物未能将棺材送出井底，极为愤怒，吼声惊天动地，即便是大铜钟也被冲击得如风中残柳，飘摇不定！
整个石山也在轰隆轰隆的剧烈抖动起来，竟似要被震得粉碎！
许应和蚖七尽管躲过了吼声的第一波冲击，但吼声与铜钟碰撞的余波传来，还是将他和蚖七掀飞，砸到数丈之外！
与此同时，破庙外的奈河也自变得狂暴起来，河面越升越高，奈河中仿佛有什么巨型魔怪，正在翻江倒海，攻打铜钟光芒形成的钟形光壁！
里应外合之下，凉亭中的大钟光芒黯淡，甚至连笼罩石山的钟形光壁也变得越来越薄，光芒越来越黯淡！
许应尽一切力量，鼓荡气血，对抗吼声，竭尽所能，拖着蛇妖蚖七向大雄宝殿走去！
他的肌肤表面，气血激荡，甚至从毛孔中渗出一颗颗小小的血珠，染红衣衫！
蛇妖蚖七已经被震得昏死过去。
许应咬紧牙关，眼中流血，鼻孔中也是一片腥气，热热的血液流出！
深井中吼声不绝，许应耳朵中也有鲜血流出，心跳如鼓，似乎随时可能爆开，一步一个血染的脚印，走向大雄宝殿。
许应艰难走上大雄宝殿，瘫软倒地。
大雄宝殿中，吼声小了许多，终于让他有了喘息的机会。
“咔嚓！”
天外有寒光闪过，像是一件锋利的兵器，只是这兵器大得惊人，将钟形光壁生生劈出一个缺口！
奈河之水顿时从缺口处倾泻下来。
许应挣扎起身，向外看去，只见奈河上，钟形光壁四周，隐约浮现出一个个高大巍峨的身影，似人非人，手持巨型兵器，攻打钟形光壁，制造出更多的缺口！
那是天神般伟岸的身影，与草头神、妖神完全不同，看一眼便脑中杂念纷生，有一种跪下膜拜的冲动！
一只惨白惨白的大手从奈河上抓来，从缺口探入破庙的上空，每一根指头长达数丈，从大雄宝殿上方掠过。

许应快步来到殿后，只见那惨白大手探入凉亭中，抓住铜钟，试图将那铜钟摘下。
“咣——”
钟声震荡，那只大手四分五裂，血肉横飞，一根指头向许应这边砸来，咄地一声，将大雄宝殿刺穿，钉在庙门上！
破旧的庙门有火光闪动，浮现出奇异的文字，扭曲如蚊虫，蕴藏不可思议的能量，将惨白手指点燃！
许应正自震惊于门上文字，突然又有一道长鞭从河面飞来，自他头顶飞过，唰地一下卷住大铜钟的钟鼻，用力向外拉去。
那悬着大钟的凉亭顿时被拉得四分五裂！
大铜钟被拉得飞离井口，井中的吼声更急。
许应仰头看向自己头顶飞速移动的长鞭，长鞭的鞭节是由一张张面色肃然的人脸组成，每一张面孔皆不相同，都是闭紧双眼。
这条奇异长鞭带着大钟，从大雄宝殿中震荡飞过，如龙游走。
奈河上又有一道道白绫飞来，唰唰钻入井中！
许应见此一幕，心中微动：“或许奈河改道，并非偶然。”
眼前这一幕，更像是有人故意让奈河改道，以达到压制荒庙大铜钟，解救井中棺的目的！
“有人为了解救井中棺，不惜制造大规模死人事件！井中棺里埋葬的，到底是什么人？”许应心中暗道。
铜钟像是被触怒，突然当当作响，震碎长鞭，飞出破庙。
庙外涛声、钟声，响成一片。
许应抬头看去，只见钟形光壁上人影幢幢，突然一个似人非人的身影脑袋炸开，被大铜钟震得粉碎！
还有一个似人非人的身影，身姿摇曳间，全身血肉突然悉数化去，接着钟形光壁上白骨的影子也化作齑粉！
许应看得心惊肉跳，那些身影给他的感觉是如此强大，如此深不可测，有如须弥之山、幽冥之渊！
然而在大铜钟的攻势下，死得却是如此干脆，比碾死一只只蝼蚁还要干脆！
滔滔奈河水，从四面八方倒灌下来，水势已经来到大雄宝殿，许应顾不得许多，拉着蛇妖蚖七纵身一跃，从大雄宝殿屋顶的破洞中跃出，落在屋顶上。

他向下看去，只见后院中，石山神黄思平单腿站在自己的百炼斩马刀上，斩马刀插入地下，奈河水已经来到他的脚底。
黄思平眼耳口鼻都是血，这尊妖神的脸上露出绝望之色。
刚才他与韦褚见机较晚，被井中传来的吼声冲击，各自身负重伤。等到清醒过来，奈河水已经流到荒庙后院，让他们无法进入大雄宝殿躲避。
现在，奈河水还在上涨之中！
河水冲刷他的脚底板，黄思平左脚血肉全无，只剩下白骨！
奈河水向上蚕食他的左腿，要不了多久，他的左腿便会只剩下骨头！
而奈河将他完全吞没，恐怕也用不了多长时间！
后院的一株枯死的老柳树上，典狱官韦褚的日子也不好过，那柳树腐朽，只剩下树身，他也只能如黄思平一般单腿站立，忍痛放弃一条腿来换得自己的性命。
然而柳树在奈河水的冲击下摇摇欲倒，随时可能被冲击得连根拔起，到那时他将死无葬身之地！
更为恐怖的是，他的个头没有黄思平高，就算柳树没有被冲倒，他也将死在黄思平前头！
许应目光落在那口深井上，只见一道道白绫缠绕着锁链向外拉去，井中，一口黑棺冉冉升起，已经来到井口。
“这些人还是得手了！”许应心道。
大铜钟被调虎离山，黑棺已经来到井口！
就在这时，一缕阳光照来，洒在少年的脸上。
许应抬头看去，东方旭日升起，照亮了他的面庞，渐渐照亮他的全身。
倾泻而来的奈河水势越来越淡，汹涌澎湃的奈河也是越来越淡，钟声也是越来越远，这条阴间长河，就这样在太阳升起时突然隐匿无踪！
许应向更远的地方看去。远处的奈河也在渐渐变淡、隐去，只留下群山间被冲刷过的“河道”。
河道中，没有半点生机，到处是枯萎腐朽的树木，像是被烧焦一样。
不远处的河床上，还有被冲刷上岸的白骨，堆积在一起。
“大钟呢？那些高大的巨人呢？”

少年四下张望，非但奈河不见踪影，那口大铜钟也消失无踪，而刚才围绕荒庙与大铜钟厮杀有如天神般的身影，也悉数消失不见！
荒庙后院没有半点水渍，甚至连篝火也不再冒绿光，变成正常的火焰。
许应定了定神，看向后院，只见深井上的凉亭倒塌，深井也恢复平静，没有响动传来。
井口坐着一个白衣少女，背对着他，缓慢的梳着披散的头发。
那少女转头看来，眼眸与许应的目光相逢，嫣然一笑，让许应只觉岁月和阳光如此美好。
阳光照到荒庙后院，少女消失不见，只剩下一口棺材立在井边。
棺材旁边，是几条黑铁锁链。
突然棺材飞起，挣脱锁链，破空而去！
“这井中被镇压的存在，还是脱困了。”
许应回忆起那少女的容貌，心道，“不过她长得挺好看，干爹和祖父肯定会喜欢这样的儿媳妇，可惜是个女鬼。”
突然，只听咚的一声，典狱官韦褚从枯树上栽倒下来，摔在地上，昏死过去。
他整条右腿变成森森白骨，没有一丁点肉！
另一边，百炼斩马刀上的石山神黄思平跳了下来，身形踉跄，面色阴沉，他的左腿小腿处也是血肉全无，只剩下骨头！
他生性凶恶，对自己也是如此，强忍疼痛，没有发出任何声音。
黄思平仰头，看向大雄宝殿上的许应。
许应面朝东方，催动导引功，在阳光的映照下，空气中飞来的光粒越来越明显，随着他的呼吸形成小规模的光粒风暴，被他吸纳入体！
这个少年体内传来阵阵雷音，又有气血化作大日，双管齐下，淬炼身体，将昨晚受伤留下的血污炼出。
现在，奈河改道的危机解除，许应所要面对的危险便不再是奈河，而是来自于神老爷和官老爷的猎杀！
黄思平长长吸气，也在调整气息，催动自己修炼的导引功，采太阳精气。
他的伤势比许应要严重很多，除了内伤之外，还损失了一条左腿。但好在他是妖王，气血修为还在，只要镇压住伤势，便可以雷霆般出手，解决许应！

现在，一人一神都在默默调息，力图在对方之前镇住伤势，恢复大部分实力，争取第一个出手抢占先机！
“许应，你本可以先走一步的。”
黄思平一边调整气息，一边淡淡道，“你很机灵，躲过了井中吼声，伤势较轻。我失去了一条腿，你逃走的话，我追不上你。你没有必要留下来。”
许应面朝东方，催动太一导引功，空中的光粒风暴越来越强烈。
少年迎着旭日阳光，体态中正如山岳临渊，有一种磅礴大气，道：“朋友昏迷，我岂能一走了之？”
黄思平目光闪动，握紧手中斩马刀：“朋友？你把蛇妖当朋友？你忘记了，你是捕蛇者！你与蛇妖是天敌！异蛇杀过你们捕蛇者，你也杀过异蛇！”
“但并不妨碍我们成为朋友！”
许应突然长啸一声，脚下重重一顿，轰隆一声坠入大雄宝殿。
后殿轰然炸开！
许应气血贯通全身，身后气血结煞，化作象神煞体，肩头一撞，将后殿一根铜柱推倒。
许应将铜柱拦腰抱起，挥舞万斤铜柱向石山神黄思平扫来！
这一战，他必须速战速决，解决掉黄思平，在其他神老爷和官老爷到来之前，带着昏死的蛇妖离开此地！
————新书求月票！！感谢误把抄书当做诗，太玄氲炁两位盟主的打赏！！！

Chapter 8: Coffin in the Well, God Outside the Temple
Huang Siping, Wei Chu and the snake demon An Qi saw that Xu Ying was stunned and looked straight at the bottom of the well, and they also looked into the well.
One person, one god and one demon, their eyes came into contact with the big eyes in the well, and their eyes became dull, looking straight at the big eyes in the well.
That big eye seemed to have a strange power, making it difficult for them to look away after just one look.
Suddenly, a deafening bell rang, shaking Xu Ying and others awake.
The two of them looked closely and saw that their hands and bodies were covered in blood. They were grabbing the thick chains in the well and struggling to pull them out!
The snake demon Gan Qi has no hands, so he uses his tail to wrap around the chain and drag it out!
They had already dragged the chain out of the well for dozens of feet. The chain that was pulled out at the back was actually covered in black blood, and the smell was astounding and disgusting.
Also dragged up together were more than a dozen human bones!
Everyone was horrified.
They have no idea when they lost their minds, or what controlled their brains, or how long they were being dragged, or what was locked under the chains!
They felt that the chain was extremely heavy and getting heavier and heavier, as if something was tied underneath.
In the well, the big eyes disappeared, and blood was gushing and bubbling. The blood was getting higher and higher, and it had reached the mouth of the well!
Xu Ying and others hurriedly released the chains, and the bell rang again. The chains fell into the well, and the blood in the well also fell back.
Suddenly, a soft sigh came from the well, which was very pleasant to hear, as if there was a young girl in the well lamenting her misfortune and being unable to escape from the well.
The louder the sound, the more creepy Xu Ying and others became.
Xu Ying stood by the well and looked down, only to see the blood receding and a coffin chained down, falling straight down the well wall.
After a while, the coffin fell to the bottom of the well.
There is a sharp triangular mouth at the bottom of the well, full of sharp teeth. It swallows the coffin into its mouth and swallows it. The chains are like beards hanging around the mouth of the huge creature.
Xu Ying's heart was pounding wildly when he saw the huge creature swallowing the coffin, then came to the bottom of the deep well and opened its mouth.
Xu Ying hurriedly shrank his head, grabbed the snake demon Gan Qi's tail and ran away!
Huang Siping and Wei Chu were puzzled. Suddenly, an earth-shattering roar came from the mouth of the well, which shocked Huang Siping and Wei Chu so much that they each groaned, and their eyes, ears, mouth and nose were filled with blood!
In the well, the huge thing failed to send the coffin out of the bottom of the well. It was extremely angry and its roar was earth-shattering. Even the big bronze bell was shaken like a willow tree in the wind, swaying unsteadily!
The entire stone mountain was also shaking violently with rumbles and rumbles, as if it was about to be shattered to pieces!
Although Xu Ying and Jian Qi escaped the first wave of the roar, the aftermath of the collision between the roar and the bell still sent him and Jian Qi flying, and they were thrown several feet away!
At the same time, the Naihe River outside the ruined temple also became violent. The river surface rose higher and higher. There seemed to be some giant monster in the Naihe River, which was overturning the river and attacking the bell-shaped wall of light formed by the light of the copper bell!
Under the combination of inside and outside, the light of the big bell in the pavilion dimmed, and even the bell-shaped light wall covering the stone mountain became thinner and thinner, and the light became dimmer and dimmer!
Xu Ying used all his strength, pumped up his energy and blood, resisted the roar, and tried his best to drag the snake demon Anchi towards the main hall!
On the surface of his skin, Qi and blood surged, and small drops of blood even seeped out from his pores, dyeing his clothes red!
The snake demon An Qi had been shocked to death.
Xu Ying gritted his teeth, his eyes were bleeding, there was a fishy smell in his nostrils, and hot blood was flowing out!
There were constant roars in the deep well, and blood flowed out of Xu Ying's ears. His heartbeat was like a drum, and it seemed that it might explode at any time. He walked towards the main hall with blood-stained footsteps step by step.
Xu Ying walked up to the main hall with difficulty and collapsed to the ground.
In the main hall, the roar became much quieter, finally giving him a chance to breathe.
"Crack!"
There was a cold light flashing outside the sky, like a sharp weapon, but this weaponIt was so huge that it split a gap into the bell-shaped wall of light!
The water of Nai River immediately poured down from the gap.
Xu Ying struggled to get up and looked outside, only to see tall and towering figures vaguely appearing around the bell-shaped wall of light on the Naihe River. They looked like humans but not humans. They were holding giant weapons and attacking the bell-shaped wall of light, creating more gaps!
It was a figure as majestic as a god, completely different from the grass-headed god and the demon god. Just one look at it made all kinds of thoughts come to mind, and there was an urge to kneel down and worship!
A big, pale hand was grabbed from the Nai River and thrust into the sky above the ruined temple through the gap. Each finger was several feet long and passed over the main hall.
Xu Ying hurried to the back of the palace and saw the big pale hand reaching into the pavilion, grabbing the bronze bell and trying to take it off.
"Bang——"
The bell vibrated, and the big hand was torn into pieces, with flesh and blood flying everywhere. A finger smashed towards Xu Ying, with a bang, it pierced the main hall and nailed it to the temple door!
There was a flash of fire at the dilapidated temple door, and strange words emerged, twisted like mosquitoes, containing incredible energy, igniting the pale fingers!
Xu Ying was shocked by the words on the door. Suddenly, another long whip flew from the river, flew over his head, and wrapped around the nose of the big bronze bell, pulling it outward with force.
The pavilion with the big bell hanging was suddenly torn apart!
The big bronze bell was pulled away from the well mouth, and the roar in the well became even louder.
Xu Ying raised his head and looked at the rapidly moving long whip above his head. The joints of the long whip were made up of human faces with solemn expressions. Each face was different and all had their eyes closed.
This strange long whip, carrying the big bell, vibrated and flew through the main hall, wandering like a dragon.
Another line of white silk came flying from the Naihe River and swished into the well!
Seeing this scene, Xu Ying felt a little moved in his heart: "Maybe it's not an accident that the Naihe River changed its course."
The scene in front of me is more like someone deliberately changing the course of the Naihe River in order to suppress the big bronze bell of the deserted temple and rescue the coffin in the well!
"In order to save the coffin in the well, some people did not hesitate to cause a large-scale death incident! Who is buried in the coffin in the well?" Xu Ying thought to himself.
As if being angered, the bronze bell suddenly clanked, shattered the whip, and flew out of the ruined temple.
Outside the temple, the sound of waves and bells rang out.
Xu Ying looked up and saw numerous human figures on the bell-shaped light wall. Suddenly, the head of a figure that looked like a human but not human exploded and was shattered by the big copper bell!
There was also a figure that looked like a human but not human. As the figure swayed, all the flesh and blood in his body suddenly melted away, and then the shadows of the bones on the bell-shaped wall of light also turned into powder!
Xu Ying was terrified when he saw it. Those figures gave him the feeling of being so powerful and unfathomable, like the Mountain of Sumeru or the Abyss of the Netherworld!
However, under the attack of the big bronze bell, his death was so simple, even simpler than crushing every ant!
The surging Naihe River poured down from all directions, and the water had already reached the Main Hall. Xu Ying didn't care much, and pulled the snake demon Anchi Qi to jump out of the hole in the roof of the Main Hall and landed on the roof.
He looked down and saw in the backyard, the Stone Mountain God Huang Siping stood with one leg on his Hundred Refined Saber. The Saber was inserted into the ground, and the Nai River water had reached the soles of his feet.
Huang Siping's eyes, ears, mouth and nose were all covered in blood, and the demon god had a look of despair on his face.
Just now, he and Wei Chu saw the opportunity late, and were hit by the roar coming from the well, and each of them was seriously injured. When they woke up, the Nai River water had flowed into the backyard of the deserted temple, making it impossible for them to enter the Mahavira Hall to escape.
Now, the water in the Nai River is still rising!
The river water washed away the soles of his feet. Huang Siping's left foot was completely gone, leaving only bones!
The water in the river is eating away at his left leg. Soon, only the bones will be left in his left leg!
And it probably won't take long for Naihe to completely swallow him up!
On a dead old willow tree in the backyard, the life of the warden Wei Chu was not easy. The willow tree rotted away, leaving onlyOn the tree body, he could only stand on one leg like Huang Siping, reluctantly giving up one leg in exchange for his life.
However, the willow tree is shaking under the impact of the Naihe River, and may be uprooted at any time. By then, he will die without a burial place!
What's even more terrifying is that he is not as tall as Huang Siping. Even if the willow tree is not knocked down, he will die in front of Huang Siping!
Xu Ying's eyes fell on the deep well, and he saw white silk ribbons wrapped around chains and being pulled outwards. In the well, a black coffin rose slowly and came to the mouth of the well.
"These people still succeeded!" Xu Ying thought.
The big bronze bell was moved away from the mountain, and the black coffin has arrived at the mouth of the well!
At this moment, a ray of sunshine came and shone on the young man's face.
Xu Ying looked up and saw the rising sun in the east, illuminating his face and gradually his whole body.
The pouring water of the Nai River is getting weaker and weaker, the surging Nai River is getting weaker and weaker, and the bells are getting farther and farther. This long river in the underworld suddenly disappears without a trace when the sun rises!
Xu Ying looked further away. The Nai River in the distance is also gradually fading and disappearing, leaving only the washed "river channel" among the mountains.
There was no life in the river, and there were withered and rotten trees everywhere, as if they were burnt.
On the riverbed not far away, there were piles of white bones that had been washed ashore.
"Where's the big clock? Where are those tall giants?"
The young man looked around. Not only was Naihe nowhere to be seen, but the big bronze bell had also disappeared. The figures who were just like gods fighting around the deserted temple and the big bronze bell had also disappeared!
There was no water stain in the backyard of the deserted temple, and even the bonfire no longer glowed green and turned into a normal flame.
Xu Ying calmed down and looked towards the backyard, only to see that the pavilion on the deep well collapsed. The deep well also returned to calm, and there was no sound.
There was a girl in white sitting at the entrance of the well, with her back to him, slowly combing her disheveled hair.
The girl turned her head to look, her eyes met Xu Ying's, and she smiled sweetly, making Xu Ying feel that the years and sunshine were so beautiful.
The sun shone into the backyard of the deserted temple, and the girl disappeared, leaving only a coffin standing by the well.
Next to the coffin are several black iron chains.
Suddenly the coffin flew up, broke free from the chains, and flew away through the air!
"The suppressed existence in this well is still out of trouble."
Xu Ying recalled the girl's appearance and thought to herself, "But she is quite good-looking. My godfather and grandfather will definitely like such a daughter-in-law. It's a pity that she is a female ghost."
Suddenly, there was a thud, and the warden Wei Chu fell from the dead tree, fell to the ground, and passed out.
His entire right leg turned into white bones without any flesh!
On the other side, the Stone Mountain God Huang Siping jumped down from the Bailian Saber. He staggered and looked gloomy. His left leg was completely devoid of flesh and blood, leaving only bones!
He was vicious by nature, and he treated himself the same way. He endured the pain without making any sound.
Huang Siping raised his head and looked at Xu Ying on the main hall.
Xu Ying faced the east and activated his Guidance Skill. Under the sunlight, the light particles flying in the air became more and more obvious. With his breathing, a small-scale light particle storm formed and was absorbed into his body!
There were thunderous sounds in the young man's body, and his energy and blood turned into the sun. He used both methods to temper his body and refine out the blood stains left by the injury last night.
Now that the crisis of Naihe diversion has been resolved, the danger Xu Ying faces is no longer Naihe, but the hunting from the gods and officials!
Huang Siping took a long breath and was also adjusting his breath, urging him to practice the Daoyin Gong to collect the essence of the sun.
His injuries were much more serious than Xu Ying's. In addition to internal injuries, he also lost a left leg. But fortunately, he is the Demon King, and his Qi and blood cultivation is still there. As long as he suppresses his injuries, he can take action like thunder to deal with Xu Ying!
Now, one person and one god are adjusting their breath silently, trying to calm down the injury before the opponent and recover most of their strength.Work hard and strive to be the first to take advantage!
"Xu Ying, you could have taken the first step."
Huang Siping said calmly while adjusting his breath, "You are very clever and escaped the roar in the well, and the injury is minor. I lost a leg. If you run away, I can't catch you. You don't need to stay."
Xu Ying faced the east and activated the Taiyi Guidance Skill, and the storm of light particles in the air became more and more intense.
Facing the rising sun, the young man's body was like a mountain facing the abyss, with a majestic atmosphere. He said: "My friend is in coma, how can I just leave?"
Huang Siping's eyes flashed, and he clenched the sword in his hand: "Friend? Do you regard the snake demon as a friend? You have forgotten that you are a snake catcher! You and the snake demon are natural enemies! Different snakes have killed your snake catchers, and you have also killed different snakes!"
"But that doesn't stop us from being friends!"
Xu Ying suddenly roared, his feet hit hard, and he fell into the main hall with a roar.
The back hall exploded with a bang!
Xu Ying's qi and blood flowed through his body, and the qi and blood behind his body became evil, turning into the evil body of the elephant god. He bumped his shoulder and knocked down a copper pillar in the back hall.
Xu Ying picked up the copper pillar by his waist and swung the thousand-jin copper pillar towards Huang Siping, the God of Stone Mountain!
In this battle, he must fight quickly, get rid of Huang Siping, and leave this place with the unconscious snake demon before the other gods and officials arrive!
